Tinsheen: 2 directions

Make me a chrome font, like the shiny metal logo on an arcade cabinet from the year 2000. - **What is it for?** One or two words at a large size, from about 80 px up: a logo, a title screen, a poster, a sticker, a high score. It is not for running text. (I chose this.) - **How should it feel?** Loud, fast and shiny. The letters are polished metal that reflects a pale sky, a sharp horizon and dark ground. (From the request.) - **What must it not look like?** A soft gradient, a blurry 3D render, or thin and elegant letters. Every tone is a flat band with a crisp edge, and the letters are heavy and leaning. (From the request. A color font in this engine has no gradients.) - **Which styles and palettes?** Two families with one style each: Tinsheen, solid chrome letters, and Tinsheen Line, the same letters hollow. Four palettes, each drawn for its own ground: Chrome, Gold, Magenta and Lime. (I chose this.)
